payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: The original mug is relocated to the right of the headphones, rather than merely adding another mug there while leaving the original mug behind.
outcome.target: Compare the source mug with the edited image: the mug should be relocated to the headphones' right, with no original mug left at its source position.
outcome.reference: Source image identifies the original blue mug on the left of the headphones. In the edited image, a blue blurred remnant remains at that left position, while a separate white mug appears to the headphones' right.

check.question: Does the edited image show the original mug relocated to the right of the headphones, rather than an additional mug placed there while the original remains?
check.complete_when: The original mug is clearly at the headphones' right and is no longer present at its source position; no evidence indicates it was duplicated.
check.partial_when: There is visible progress toward relocating the original mug, but it remains at its source position or the relocation is otherwise incomplete.
check.absent_when: The original mug remains at its source position and there is no visible progress relocating it; a separate mug at the right alone does not count as progress on moving the original.
check.unknown_when: The source mug cannot be matched to the edited image, or the images do not provide enough evidence to determine whether it was relocated or duplicated.

response.content: {"status":"absent","evidence":"The original blue mug remains as a blurred blue remnant at its source position. A separate white mug appears to the headphones’ right, so the original mug is not visibly relocated."}
